stories.title: LHC directs Noreen Niazi’s counsel to file separate plea for medical treatment, family meetings
stories.brief: LAHORE: The Lahore High Court on Friday directed the counsel for Noreen Niazi, sister of former prime minister and PTI founder Imran Khan, to file a separate miscellaneous application seeking medical treatment and family meetings.

stories.title: LHC asks Noreen Niazi's counsel to file separate plea for medical care, family access
stories.brief: PTI Secretary General Salman Akram Raja also appeared before the court and raised concerns over Noreen's medical condition. Raja calls Noreen's detention unjustified Raja criticised the continued detention of Imran's three sisters, saying there was no justification for keeping Noreen in custody despite her illness.

stories.title: Binance's $6.3bn hack: How crypto insurance works
stories.brief: Digital asset insurance is a range of policies designed to protect cryptocurrency exchanges, custodians and other companies operating in the sector against financial losses arising from the theft of digital assets, cyberattacks, technology failures and other business risks.

stories.title: Binance freezes assets after $6.3 billion heist, crypto industry's biggest
stories.brief: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, in what analysts say is the biggest crypto hack ever, an attack that could prompt investors to rethink the risks of ​owning digital assets.

stories.brief: Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal on Thursday ruled out the possibility of an immediate reduction in petroleum levy rates under any pressure from Jamaat-e-Islami but said that the government would consider a gradual decrease in rates from the next budget.
